hero.lede: CHRON.OS helps people and teams build archives that remember where files came from, why they matter, and when they need attention — without making the cloud the source of truth.

console.releaseBody: Portable ZIP remains available for no-install testing.

pipeline.label: Source
pipeline.description: Original path and intake context remain visible.

pipeline.label: Hash
pipeline.description: Every artifact gets a cryptographic anchor.

pipeline.label: Metadata
pipeline.description: Sidecar facts stay local and inspectable.

pipeline.label: Meaning
pipeline.description: User-weighted context can evolve over time.

capabilities.title: Capture
capabilities.copy: Copy important files into a working archive without mutating originals.

capabilities.title: Provenance
capabilities.copy: Preserve source paths, hashes, sidecar metadata, and intake context.

capabilities.title: Govern
capabilities.copy: Track age, context, search posture, and review-ready archive state.

capabilities.title: Stage
capabilities.copy: Keep automation, retention, and interop behind explicit gates.

audiences.title: Individuals
audiences.copy: Recover messy downloads, old documents, scattered project files, research folders, and forgotten archives without losing where they came from.
audiences.label: Personal archive recovery

audiences.title: Teams
audiences.copy: Preserve provenance, review aging files, standardize archive rules, and prepare policy-based retention workflows before automation is enabled.
audiences.label: Operational file custody

audiences.title: Organizations
audiences.copy: Use CHRON.OS as the archive layer inside a broader local-first Hyperion deployment, with deeper interop lanes staged until policy and trust gates are ready.
audiences.label: Local-first archive layer

staged: cloud, NAS, and production OAuth polish
full multimodal inference and retention workflows

videoLanes.title: Public beta tour
videoLanes.copy: Show the installer lane, local intake, provenance trail, search posture, and beta boundaries using synthetic demo data.

videoLanes.title: Safety workflow
videoLanes.copy: Explain the trust model: copy and index first, originals untouched, destructive actions gated by explicit operator policy.

videoLanes.title: Archive policy wedge
videoLanes.copy: Frame the individual, team, and organization use cases without claiming enterprise production readiness.

release.recommendation: Recommended for most Windows users: one-click installer. Portable ZIP is for no-install testing or users who already have the required runtime pieces.
